topic.title: $10 million doing nothing out-earns a $500,000 salary

cta: Salary or money at work? Comment
title: The $500,000 surgeon vs the $10 million heir 🤫
description:
Can $10 million that never goes to work out-earn a $500,000 salary?
One year: the surgeon works every shift; the heir's money sits invested at an assumed 7% a year, computed. Returns are assumptions, never promises. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
